input.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting above groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
- **“What you will need on day one.” — Mandatory:** Python and SQL. “Will need” indicates requirements, and “on day one” means they’re expected from the start.
- **“What would make you stand out.” — Optional:** Grafana and technical writing. “Would make you stand out” frames them as advantages that distinguish a candidate, rather than prerequisites.
